visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins with a grey tabby cat sleeping deeply in a cozy bed with a brown pillow and a matching brown blanket. The cat is wearing a grey fish-shaped eye mask, and its two white paws rest symmetrically on the top edge of the blanket against a flat grey background. (2) A small ginger-colored cat with transparent wings, resembling a fly, enters the scene. It hovers near the sleeping cat's head, squinting its eyes and covering its mouth with a paw while performing a mischievous, silent laughing gesture. (3) The fly-like ginger cat pulls out a small yellow trumpet and blows it directly into the sleeping cat's face. The tabby cat's eyes snap open with an expression of intense irritation. It quickly reaches out, catches the fly cat, and squashes it flat against the bed surface in a comedic, sticker-like manner. (4) The ginger fly cat returns, giggling again as it hovers. This time, it uses a long, thin brown stick or straw to tickle the sleeping tabby cat's pink nose. The tabby cat's nose twitches in response while its eyes remain closed. (5) The tabby cat wakes up again, looking extremely angry with red veins visible in its eyes. It holds up an electric device that emits bright white flashes of electricity, shocking the fly cat until it vibrates and glows from the current. (6) The persistent fly cat appears once more, holding a microphone and singing with its mouth wide open in a performance pose. The tabby cat pulls out a white pressurized can and sprays a thick cloud of bug spray directly at the fly. The ginger fly cat's eyes turn into 'X' shapes as it falls out of the frame.
